notes.title: Big update for Fadry!
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b] This update brings a large amount of fixes and improvements. (Big thank you to WhoStolemyTea, whose playthrough and suggestions these changes are a result of!)



- A line of dialogue telling the player where to go to progress during a certain quest in Rose in Chapter 1 now repeats in case the player forgets.

- Small visual additions to Rose in Chapter 1 to help guide the player to the southern part of the village

- Stopped music from playing in a scene where it shouldn't in Rose in Chapter 1

- Made Rose in Chapter 1 more forgiving by reducing the amount of suspicion certain actions raise

- Added a line of dialogue to help inform the player about one of the possible solutions to a quest in Rose in Chapter 1

- Added some lines to Reila in Rose in Chapter 1

- Made it more obvious that the player may explore the basement section of the Library of Derva in Chapter 1

- Slightly reworked a scene featuring a certain elf in Arberg in Chapter 1

- Added some more lines highlighting a certain character's attitude shifting depending on choices made in Chapter 1

- Removed a certain choice in early on in Chapter 2 because the it stretched logic a bit too much

- Added a warning regarding the true weight of a certain gameplay decision and its consequences in Chapter 2

- Added an explanation regarding the section in the mines in Chapter 2

- Fixed a few bugs in the mines section in Chapter 2

- Removed a small feature in the mines section of Chapter 2 that could cause annoyance for players utilising cheat codes

- Removed a semi-hidden way to skip part of the mines section in Chapter 2

- Gave the player some healing items for Chapter 2

- Increased the duration of light source items used in the mines in Chapter 2

- Gave the player more control over their supplies and gear in the mines section in Chapter 2. This means several things. The player can now properly pause in the mines. Instead of being prompted to reload their firearms when they are empty, the player will have to remember to do this every time they are used, as the prompt was reported as annoying to some. The player is now able to use the newly added healing items here. The player will now be able to use light source items even if it is not necessary to avoid having to wait around for the duration of their previous light source to expire.

- Changed the description of certain spells to better explain their effects

- Added a tiny detail near the start of Chapter 3 for better consistency with Lea's implied abilities

- The Bipedal Wolves at the start of Chapter 3 are now immune to weaker forms of the bleed status effect. Previously, a skill could be used to make the fight against them incredibly easy. This weakness also didn't make sense considering the implied abilities of these creatures in the game's lore

- Fixed a missing trigger that was supposed to move the player to a new area at the start Chapter 4, but could be walked over without properly triggering

- In Chapter 4 in the first swamp section, there was a little bit of dry land that looked traversable but wasn't, potentially leading to confusion and irritation for the player at having to walk around it. This piece of dry land is now traversable

- Fixed a weird little thing in a lorebook in Chapter 4 in regards to a certain character's very long name not properly fitting in a text box as intended

- Added some missing collision to several objects in certain sections of Chapter 4

- Fixed a character not turning in your direction when spoken to from certain angles during a specific scene in Chapter 4

- Fixed the player character facing the wrong direction on a few occasions early on in the expansion

- Fixed typos in this post

notes.title: First Expansion: "Martja the Unlucky"
notes.content:
Hello.

This update includes the new expansion, [i]Martja the Unlucky[/i]. It is set a few years after the events of the main game, with a length of 1 hour.




There's also some other stuff. Mostly fixes (big thank you to the cool person who reported all of the bugs):

- Gave Lea new lines at various points throughout Chapter 3.

Fixed bug which could force you to reload a save in New Derva. Fortunately the conditions for it to happen were pretty convoluted.

Fixed bug which could get you stuck inside a wall in Chapter 2's Goldspear.

Fixed some spots where you could walk through walls and such.

Fixed a bug which allowed you to repeat the worm hunting quest in Chapter 3's Rose.

Fixed a bug where you could rent a room multiple times in Chapter 3's Rose.

Fixed possible bug where you could sleep in Chapter 3's Rose without renting the room.

notes.title: Various things patch
notes.content:
Hello!
It's time for another patch of small improvements and fixes!

- Improved Chapter 3's section with Martja. This is mostly dialogue changes.
- Added a new item with some flavour text which does a bit of worldbuilding.
- Some changes to combat in Chapter 1. Mostly just a balance change.
- Visual changes. I don't remember where exactly they all are. I know for sure there were some in Chapter 1's Rose.
- Some things were cut and some things were added from the very start of the game up until the end of Chapter 1's Rose. Dialogue was cut, added and changed to make Rose more forgiving in how it guides the plyer through the quests. Mostly, a hint was added here and there.

In summary, this patch fleshes out both Martja and Lea a bit more in preparation for the upcoming expansion, and also has some things to make the start of a playthrough a bit smoother.
As always, feel free to tell me if this update makes your pc explode or something so I can fix it later.

notes.title: Fixes and stuff
notes.content:
Hello!

Most importantly: fixed an issue that could prevent any progress in the game if a certain choice was made. This issue was first reported recently, so I hope no one else encountered it, as it forced you to reload a save to before the choice was made, losing around 15 minutes of progress.

Fixed issues regarding a certain choice near the beginning of Chapter 2, including a line of dialogue repeating and the player receiving more items than intended in the form of duplicates.

Gave several lines of dialogue to the barkeep in Derva.

Added decorations and a minor NPC to the port in Chapter 3.

notes.title: Small stuff update
notes.content:
Hello!

My combing through some of the latest content revealed a few issues. Today's update (technically there were actually two seperate ones) has fixed some miscellaneous, small things;

There was a message from me to players who made it through the entire game up to this point, but it could not be accessed.

A certain character briefly returns near the end of Chapter 3 if you made certain choices. During this, there was internal monologue describing a scene. This was improved, making the situation clearer. This character also mentioned a date, which was off by 2 years because I am bad at math. Formatting was also slightly adjusted to make dialogue flow better.

In Chapter 3, the optional quest taking the player through a small village and its forest has some additional hints that point the player in the right direction, as the conclusion to this quest was easily missable.

notes.title: Fadry Chapter 3 Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

Chapter 3 of [i]Fadry[/i] is now out! The game is now very much nearing completion, and you will certainly feel that in this Chapter! Many previous choices will now become a bit more relevant again, and the story marches on! I hope you all like the new characters, and the things they get up to.
